name: request_callback
description: Schedules a call from a human advisor: financial hardship without a policy option, the customer asks for a person, a third party asks to reach the account holder, or anything you cannot resolve. Works without identity verification.

reason.description: One sentence in Spanish on why an advisor should call, without names, ID numbers or other personal data.

preferred_window.description: When the customer prefers the call, in Spanish, for example "mañana en la mañana". If they did not say, use "siguiente día hábil".
